title: Family wellness retreat in March (Help me choose)
request: I want to go on a trip with my family over spring, March 19-29. Preferably a nice retreat. I want to feel good because life has been stressful recently. Outdoors stuff.

overview:
THIS TRIP

11 days in Tenerife, built around beaches and swimming, food and towns and easy nature walks.

WHERE YOU SLEEP
1
Puerto de la Cruz
10
nights

One base, Puerto de la Cruz: also sleeping in Santiago del Teide / Los Gigantes would save about 45 minutes of travel a day over 5 days, but the move would cost about 1 h 55 of packing up, checking in and travelling.

WHAT THIS PLAN STILL LACKS

Unhurried time on a beach: 2 of the 3 a trip like this needs. Add beach days on the Discovery Board.
What the destination is known for (Teide National Park) is not in the plan, although the board offers it. Keep at least one of these on the Discovery Board and rebuild.

overview:
THIS TRIP

9 days in Tanzania, built around scenic viewpoints, history and culture and easy nature walks.

WHERE YOU SLEEP
1
Karatu / Lake Manyara area
8
nights

One base, Karatu / Lake Manyara area: also sleeping in Arusha would save about 1 h 45 of travel a day over 3 days and reach 2 more places, but the move would cost about 4 h 20 of packing up, checking in and travelling.

7 days are lighter than they should be: Sidequest could not put 25 of the places it found on the map. That is Sidequest's to fix — nothing for you to do.

WHAT THIS PLAN STILL LACKS

Game drives in the parks: 2 of the 3 a trip like this needs. Add game drives in the parks on the Discovery Board; an operator-run circuit is the usual way.
What the destination is known for (Ngorongoro Crater floor game drive, Tarangire National Park game drives) is not in the plan, although the board offers it. Keep at least one of these on the Discovery Board and rebuild.

SIGNATURE EXPERIENCES

A low-key sunset viewpoint over the Karatu farmlands near the crater rim lodges.

Stays quiet even in season, which matters more to you than a famous name.
III · DAY 8
Mto wa Mbu market
A produce and craft market on the route, good for a quick local-life stop without a special trip.
